## Context

Week N of 52 in [Caminho das Pedras](../ROADMAP.md): <matéria>.

- **Week:** a plan week has 10 days (Sunday → Tuesday of the next week) or 11 days (Wednesday → Saturday of the next week)
- **Blocks:** 1h of study every day, by weekday: Fundamentals Sun, Mon, Wed, Thu · LeetCode Tue, Fri · Blank page Sat. Then 1h of project every day (you pick the project; tracked in its own repo) · HUB +25 min Mon–Fri
- **In 10 days:** 6 Fundamentals, 3 LeetCode, 1 blank page. **In 11 days:** the same plus 1 more blank page, used as the spare hour (catch-up or review)
